```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 14 — BULK RNA-SEQ VALIDATION — TCGA
#==============================================================================
#
# Purpose:
#   Validate a candidate gene identified from single-cell and spatial analyses
#   using TCGA bulk RNA-seq data obtained through UCSC Xena.
#
# Analyses:
#   1. Download TCGA RNA-seq and clinical data
#   2. Download/load TCGA survival data
#   3. Retain primary tumor samples
#   4. Define target-gene high and low tumors
#   5. Differential expression analysis
#   6. Volcano plot and DEG heatmap
#   7. Hallmark and GO Biological Process GSEA
#   8. xCell, MCP-counter, and ESTIMATE deconvolution
#   9. High vs low immune-deconvolution comparisons
#  10. Target-gene correlations with xCell populations
#  11. Target-gene correlations with ESTIMATE / tumor purity
#  12. Overall survival analysis
#
# Main settings to change:
#
#   tcga_project <- "GBM"
#   target_gene  <- "PRKCD"
#
#==============================================================================


#==============================================================================
# 1. Libraries
#==============================================================================

library(UCSCXenaTools)
library(here)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

library(limma)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)

library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)

library(immunedeconv)

library(survival)
library(survminer)

set.seed(1234)


#==============================================================================
# 2. User settings
#==============================================================================

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TCGA cancer project
#
# Examples:
#   GBM  = Glioblastoma
#   LGG  = Lower-grade glioma
#   BRCA = Breast cancer
#   LUAD = Lung adenocarcinoma
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

tcga_project <- "GBM"


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Target gene
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

target_gene <- "PRKCD"



#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Differential-expression thresholds
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dea_fdr_threshold <- 0.05
dea_logfc_threshold <- 1


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GSEA settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

gsea_fdr_threshold <- 0.05
gsea_min_size <- 15
gsea_max_size <- 500
gsea_top_pathways <- 10


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

volcano_label_genes <- 15
heatmap_top_genes <- 25

correlation_fdr_threshold <- 0.05


#==============================================================================
# 3. Analysis identifier
#==============================================================================

analysis_prefix <- paste(
  "TCGA",
  tcga_project,
  target_gene,
  sep = "_"
)


#==============================================================================
# 4. Project directory structure
#==============================================================================

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Raw bulk RNA-seq data downloaded from UCSC Xena
#
# data/raw/bulk/GBM/
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

tcga_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "bulk",
  tcga_project
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Processed bulk data
#
# data/processed/bulk/GBM/PRKCD/
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_data_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "bulk",
  tcga_project,
  target_gene
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main bulk results directory
#
# results/bulk/GBM/PRKCD/
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "bulk",
  tcga_project,
  target_gene
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Results subdirectories
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dea_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "DEA"
)

gsea_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "GSEA"
)

immune_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "immune_deconvolution"
)

correlation_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "correlations"
)

survival_results_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "survival"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main bulk figure directory
#
# figures/bulk/GBM/PRKCD/
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

figures_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "bulk",
  tcga_project,
  target_gene
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure subdirectories
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dea_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "DEA"
)

gsea_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "GSEA"
)

immune_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "immune_deconvolution"
)

correlation_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "correlations"
)

survival_figure_directory <- file.path(
  figures_directory,
  "survival"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create directories
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

output_directories <- c(
  tcga_directory,
  processed_data_directory,
  results_directory,
  dea_results_directory,
  gsea_results_directory,
  immune_results_directory,
  correlation_results_directory,
  survival_results_directory,
  figures_directory,
  dea_figure_directory,
  gsea_figure_directory,
  immune_figure_directory,
  correlation_figure_directory,
  survival_figure_directory
)

for (directory in output_directories) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Print directory structure
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "TCGA BULK RNA-SEQ VALIDATION\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "TCGA project: ", tcga_project, "\n",
  "Target gene:  ", target_gene, "\n",
  "\nRepository root:\n",
  here::here(),
  "\n\nRaw bulk data:\n",
  tcga_directory,
  "\n\nProcessed bulk data:\n",
  processed_data_directory,
  "\n\nBulk results:\n",
  results_directory,
  "\n\nBulk figures:\n",
  figures_directory,
  "\n============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


#==============================================================================
# 5. Helper functions
#==============================================================================

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save ggplot objects as PNG and PDF
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

save_ggplot <- function(
  plot_object,
  filename,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      filename,
      ".png"
    ),
    plot = plot_object,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      filename,
      ".pdf"
    ),
    plot = plot_object,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Safe Spearman correlation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

safe_spearman <- function(
  x,
  y
) {
  keep <- complete.cases(
    x,
    y
  )

  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]

  if (
    length(x) < 3 ||
    length(unique(x)) < 2 ||
    length(unique(y)) < 2
  ) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        n_samples = length(x),
        correlation = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      x,
      y,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  data.frame(
    n_samples = length(x),
    correlation = unname(
      test$estimate
    ),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare immunedeconv output
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

prepare_deconvolution_long <- function(
  deconvolution_results,
  method_name,
  sample_metadata
) {
  deconvolution_results %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -cell_type,
      names_to = "sample",
      values_to = "score"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      score = as.numeric(
        score
      ),
      method = method_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      sample_metadata %>%
        dplyr::select(
          sample,
          target_expression,
          target_group
        ),
      by = "sample"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(score),
      !is.na(target_expression),
      !is.na(target_group)
    )
}


#==============================================================================
# 6. Identify TCGA RNA-seq and clinical datasets
#==============================================================================

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "TCGA DATA DOWNLOAD\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

cat(
  "\nChecking TCGA-",
  tcga_project,
  " datasets...\n",
  sep = ""
)

tcga_info <- UCSCXenaTools::getTCGAdata(
  project = tcga_project,
  clinical = TRUE,
  mRNASeq = TRUE,
  mRNASeqType = "normalized",
  download = FALSE
)

data_info_columns <- intersect(
  c(
    "XenaDatasets",
    "SampleCount",
    "DataType",
    "FileType"
  ),
  colnames(
    tcga_info$DataInfo
  )
)

cat(
  "\nDatasets selected by UCSCXenaTools:\n\n"
)

print(
  tcga_info$DataInfo[
    ,
    data_info_columns,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)


#==============================================================================
# 7. Download TCGA RNA-seq and clinical data
#==============================================================================

cat(
  "\nDownloading TCGA-",
  tcga_project,
  " RNA-seq and clinical data...\n",
  sep = ""
)

tcga_download <- UCSCXenaTools::getTCGAdata(
  project = tcga_project,
  clinical = TRUE,
  mRNASeq = TRUE,
  mRNASeqType = "normalized",
  download = TRUE,
  destdir = tcga_directory
)

cat(
  "\nDownload information:\n\n"
)

print(
  tcga_download
)


#==============================================================================
# 8. Prepare downloaded TCGA data
#==============================================================================

tcga_data <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaPrepare(
  tcga_download
)

cat(
  "\nObjects returned by XenaPrepare:\n\n"
)

print(
  names(
    tcga_data
  )
)

cat(
  "\nObject dimensions:\n\n"
)

print(
  lapply(
    tcga_data,
    dim
  )
)


#==============================================================================
# 9. Identify expression and clinical objects
#==============================================================================

rna_object_name <- grep(
  "^HiSeqV2(\\.gz)?$",
  names(
    tcga_data
  ),
  value = TRUE
)

if (length(rna_object_name) != 1) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Could not uniquely identify HiSeqV2.\n",
      paste(
        names(tcga_data),
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    )
  )
}

clinical_object_name <- grep(
  "clinicalMatrix",
  names(
    tcga_data
  ),
  value = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(clinical_object_name) != 1) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Could not uniquely identify clinicalMatrix.\n",
      paste(
        names(tcga_data),
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    )
  )
}

expression_data <- tcga_data[[rna_object_name]]
clinical_data <- tcga_data[[clinical_object_name]]

cat(
  "\nRNA-seq object: ",
  rna_object_name,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Clinical object: ",
  clinical_object_name,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nRNA-seq dimensions:\n"
)

print(
  dim(
    expression_data
  )
)

cat(
  "\nClinical dimensions:\n"
)

print(
  dim(
    clinical_data
  )
)


#==============================================================================
# 10. Download or locate survival data
#==============================================================================

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "TCGA SURVIVAL DATA\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

survival_file <- file.path(
  tcga_directory,
  "survival",
  paste0(
    tcga_project,
    "_survival.txt"
  )
)

if (!file.exists(survival_file)) {
  cat(
    "\nSurvival file not found locally.\n",
    "Searching UCSC Xena...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  xena_tcga <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaGenerate(
    subset = XenaHostNames == "tcgaHub"
  )

  survival_dataset_name <- paste0(
    "survival/",
    tcga_project,
    "_survival.txt"
  )

  survival_xena <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaFilter(
    xena_tcga,
    filterDatasets = survival_dataset_name
  )

  available_survival_datasets <- UCSCXenaTools::datasets(
    survival_xena
  )

  if (!survival_dataset_name %in% available_survival_datasets) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Could not locate survival dataset:\n",
        survival_dataset_name
      )
    )
  }

  cat(
    "\nSurvival dataset found: ",
    survival_dataset_name,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  survival_query <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaQuery(
    survival_xena
  )

  cat(
    "\nSurvival download query:\n\n"
  )

  print(
    survival_query
  )

  survival_download <- UCSCXenaTools::XenaDownload(
    survival_query,
    destdir = tcga_directory
  )

  cat(
    "\nSurvival download complete.\n"
  )
}

if (!file.exists(survival_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Survival file was not found:\n",
      survival_file
    )
  )
}


#==============================================================================
# 11. Load survival data
#==============================================================================

survival_data_raw <- readr::read_tsv(
  survival_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nSurvival dimensions:\n"
)

print(
  dim(
    survival_data_raw
  )
)

cat(
  "\nSurvival variables:\n\n"
)

print(
  colnames(
    survival_data_raw
  )
)


#==============================================================================
# 12. Prepare expression matrix
#==============================================================================

expression_data <- as.data.frame(
  expression_data,
  check.names = FALSE
)

gene_column <- colnames(
  expression_data
)[1]

gene_names <- as.character(
  expression_data[[gene_column]]
)

expression_matrix <- as.matrix(
  expression_data[
    ,
    setdiff(
      colnames(
        expression_data
      ),
      gene_column
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

storage.mode(
  expression_matrix
) <- "numeric"

rownames(
  expression_matrix
) <- gene_names

valid_gene_rows <- !is.na(
  rownames(
    expression_matrix
  )
) &
  rownames(
    expression_matrix
  ) != ""

expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[
  valid_gene_rows,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (
  anyDuplicated(
    rownames(
      expression_matrix
    )
  ) > 0
) {
  expression_matrix <- limma::avereps(
    expression_matrix
  )
}

cat(
  "\nFull expression matrix:\n"
)

print(
  dim(
    expression_matrix
  )
)


#==============================================================================
# 13. Retain primary tumor samples
#==============================================================================

# TCGA sample-type code 01 = Primary Solid Tumor.

sample_barcodes <- colnames(
  expression_matrix
)

sample_type <- substr(
  sample_barcodes,
  14,
  15
)

primary_samples <- sample_barcodes[
  sample_type == "01"
]

if (length(primary_samples) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No TCGA primary tumor samples were found."
  )
}

expression_primary <- expression_matrix[
  ,
  primary_samples,
  drop = FALSE
]

cat(
  "\nPrimary tumor samples retained: ",
  ncol(
    expression_primary
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#==============================================================================
# 14. Confirm target gene
#==============================================================================

if (
  !target_gene %in%
    rownames(
      expression_primary
    )
) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Target gene ",
      target_gene,
      " was not found in the expression matrix."
    )
  )
}


#==============================================================================
# 15. Define target-gene expression groups
#==============================================================================

target_expression <- as.numeric(
  expression_primary[
    target_gene,
    ,
    drop = TRUE
  ]
)

names(
  target_expression
) <- colnames(
  expression_primary
)

target_cutpoint <- median(
  target_expression,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

target_group <- ifelse(
  target_expression > target_cutpoint,
  "High",
  "Low"
)

target_group <- factor(
  target_group,
  levels = c(
    "Low",
    "High"
  )
)

sample_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(
    expression_primary
  ),
  patient = substr(
    colnames(
      expression_primary
    ),
    1,
    12
  ),
  target_expression = target_expression,
  target_group = target_group,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nTarget gene: ",
  target_gene,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Median expression cutpoint: ",
  round(
    target_cutpoint,
    4
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nExpression groups:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    sample_metadata$target_group
  )
)


#==============================================================================
# 16. Save processed bulk data
#==============================================================================

write.csv(
  sample_metadata,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_sample_metadata.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  sample_metadata,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_sample_metadata.rds"
    )
  )
)

saveRDS(
  expression_primary,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_primary_tumor_expression.rds"
    )
  )
)

saveRDS(
  clinical_data,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_clinical_data.rds"
    )
  )
)

saveRDS(
  survival_data_raw,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_survival_data_raw.rds"
    )
  )
)


#==============================================================================
# 17. Differential expression analysis
#==============================================================================

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

design <- model.matrix(
  ~ 0 + target_group
)

colnames(
  design
) <- c(
  "Low",
  "High"
)

fit <- limma::lmFit(
  expression_primary,
  design
)

contrast_matrix <- limma::makeContrasts(
  High_vs_Low = High - Low,
  levels = design
)

fit <- limma::contrasts.fit(
  fit,
  contrast_matrix
)

fit <- limma::eBayes(
  fit
)

dea_results <- limma::topTable(
  fit,
  coef = "High_vs_Low",
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by = "P"
)

dea_results <- dea_results %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    var = "gene"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      adj.P.Val < dea_fdr_threshold &
        logFC >= dea_logfc_threshold ~ "Up",
      adj.P.Val < dea_fdr_threshold &
        logFC <= -dea_logfc_threshold ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )

cat(
  "\nUpregulated genes: ",
  sum(
    dea_results$significance == "Up"
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Downregulated genes: ",
  sum(
    dea_results$significance == "Down"
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

write.csv(
  dea_results,
  file.path(
    dea_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_DEA.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  dea_results,
  file.path(
    dea_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_DEA.rds"
    )
  )
)


#==============================================================================
# 18. Volcano plot
#==============================================================================

volcano_data <- dea_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    minus_log10_fdr = -log10(
      pmax(
        adj.P.Val,
        .Machine$double.xmin
      )
    )
  )

volcano_labels <- volcano_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance != "NS"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    adj.P.Val
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = volcano_label_genes
  )

volcano_plot <- ggplot(
  volcano_data,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = minus_log10_fdr,
    color = significance
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.65,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(
      -dea_logfc_threshold,
      dea_logfc_threshold
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(
      dea_fdr_threshold
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = volcano_labels,
    aes(
      label = gene
    ),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Down" = "blue",
      "NS" = "grey",
      "Up" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "TCGA-",
      tcga_project,
      ": ",
      target_gene,
      "-high vs ",
      target_gene,
      "-low"
    ),
    x = "log2 fold change",
    y = "-log10 FDR",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

# Display plot.
print(
  volcano_plot
)

# Save plot.
save_ggplot(
  volcano_plot,
  file.path(
    dea_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_volcano"
    )
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 7
)


#==============================================================================
# 19. Differential-expression heatmap
#==============================================================================

heatmap_genes <- dea_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance != "NS",
    gene != target_gene
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    adj.P.Val
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = heatmap_top_genes
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    gene
  )

if (length(heatmap_genes) >= 2) {
  heatmap_matrix <- expression_primary[
    heatmap_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  heatmap_annotation <- data.frame(
    Group = sample_metadata$target_group
  )

  rownames(
    heatmap_annotation
  ) <- sample_metadata$sample

  sample_order <- order(
    sample_metadata$target_group,
    sample_metadata$target_expression
  )

  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[
    ,
    sample_metadata$sample[
      sample_order
    ],
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  heatmap_annotation <- heatmap_annotation[
    sample_metadata$sample[
      sample_order
    ],
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  heatmap_plot <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    scale = "row",
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    annotation_col = heatmap_annotation,
    border_color = NA,
    fontsize_row = 9,
    main = paste0(
      "TCGA-",
      tcga_project,
      ": ",
      target_gene,
      "-associated genes"
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  # Display heatmap.
  grid::grid.newpage()

  grid::grid.draw(
    heatmap_plot$gtable
  )

  # Save PNG.
  png(
    filename = file.path(
      dea_figure_directory,
      paste0(
        analysis_prefix,
        "_heatmap.png"
      )
    ),
    width = 3000,
    height = 2200,
    res = 300
  )

  grid::grid.draw(
    heatmap_plot$gtable
  )

  dev.off()

  # Save PDF.
  pdf(
    file = file.path(
      dea_figure_directory,
      paste0(
        analysis_prefix,
        "_heatmap.pdf"
      )
    ),
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )

  grid::grid.draw(
    heatmap_plot$gtable
  )

  dev.off()
}


#==============================================================================
# 20. Prepare ranked genes for GSEA
#==============================================================================

# Limma moderated t-statistic used for pre-ranked GSEA.

gsea_ranks <- dea_results$t

names(
  gsea_ranks
) <- dea_results$gene

gsea_ranks <- gsea_ranks[
  is.finite(
    gsea_ranks
  )
]

gsea_ranks <- sort(
  gsea_ranks,
  decreasing = TRUE
)


#==============================================================================
# 21. GSEA helper function
#==============================================================================

run_gsea_collection <- function(
  collection_name,
  output_label,
  subcollection_name = NULL
) {
  cat(
    "\nRunning ",
    output_label,
    " GSEA...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  if (is.null(subcollection_name)) {
    gene_sets <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
      species = "Homo sapiens",
      collection = collection_name
    )
  } else {
    gene_sets <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
      species = "Homo sapiens",
      collection = collection_name,
      subcollection = subcollection_name
    )
  }

  pathway_list <- split(
    gene_sets$gene_symbol,
    gene_sets$gs_name
  )

  pathway_list <- lapply(
    pathway_list,
    unique
  )

  gsea_result <- fgsea::fgsea(
    pathways = pathway_list,
    stats = gsea_ranks,
    minSize = gsea_min_size,
    maxSize = gsea_max_size,
    eps = 0
  )

  gsea_result <- as.data.frame(
    gsea_result
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      padj
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction = ifelse(
        NES > 0,
        "High",
        "Low"
      )
    )

  gsea_save <- gsea_result

  if ("leadingEdge" %in% colnames(gsea_save)) {
    gsea_save$leadingEdge <- vapply(
      gsea_save$leadingEdge,
      paste,
      collapse = ";",
      FUN.VALUE = character(1)
    )
  }

  write.csv(
    gsea_save,
    file.path(
      gsea_results_directory,
      paste0(
        analysis_prefix,
        "_",
        output_label,
        "_GSEA.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  significant_gsea <- gsea_result %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(padj),
      padj < gsea_fdr_threshold
    )

  cat(
    output_label,
    " significant pathways: ",
    nrow(
      significant_gsea
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  if (nrow(significant_gsea) > 0) {
    gsea_plot_data <- significant_gsea %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        direction
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        padj,
        .by_group = TRUE
      ) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(
        n = gsea_top_pathways
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        pathway_label = gsub(
          "^HALLMARK_|^GOBP_",
          "",
          pathway
        ),
        pathway_label = gsub(
          "_",
          " ",
          pathway_label
        ),
        minus_log10_fdr = -log10(
          pmax(
            padj,
            .Machine$double.xmin
          )
        )
      )

    gsea_plot <- ggplot(
      gsea_plot_data,
      aes(
        x = NES,
        y = reorder(
          pathway_label,
          NES
        ),
        size = minus_log10_fdr,
        color = direction
      )
    ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ) +
      geom_point(
        alpha = 0.9
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "High" = "red",
          "Low" = "blue"
        )
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          "TCGA-",
          tcga_project,
          " ",
          target_gene,
          " GSEA"
        ),
        subtitle = output_label,
        x = "Normalized enrichment score",
        y = NULL,
        size = "-log10 FDR",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      theme_classic(
        base_size = 11
      ) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold"
        )
      )

    # Display plot.
    print(
      gsea_plot
    )

    # Save plot.
    save_ggplot(
      gsea_plot,
      file.path(
        gsea_figure_directory,
        paste0(
          analysis_prefix,
          "_",
          output_label,
          "_GSEA_dotplot"
        )
      ),
      width = 10,
      height = 8
    )
  }

  return(
    gsea_result
  )
}

#==============================================================================
# 29. High vs low immune-deconvolution statistics
#==============================================================================

immune_statistics <- immune_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    method,
    cell_type
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_low = sum(
      target_group == "Low"
    ),
    n_high = sum(
      target_group == "High"
    ),
    median_low = median(
      score[
        target_group == "Low"
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_high = median(
      score[
        target_group == "High"
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_difference = median_high - median_low,
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(
        score ~ target_group,
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) {
        NA_real_
      }
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

cat(
  "\nImmune-deconvolution statistics:\n\n"
)

print(
  immune_statistics %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      p_adjusted
    )
)

#==============================================================================
# 38. Prepare survival data
#==============================================================================

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "OVERALL SURVIVAL ANALYSIS\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

sample_column_candidates <- c(
  "sample",
  "_PATIENT",
  "sampleID",
  "SampleID",
  "patient",
  "bcr_patient_barcode"
)

sample_column <- sample_column_candidates[
  sample_column_candidates %in%
    colnames(
      survival_data_raw
    )
][1]

if (
  length(sample_column) == 0 ||
  is.na(sample_column)
) {
  sample_column <- colnames(
    survival_data_raw
  )[1]
}

required_survival_columns <- c(
  "OS",
  "OS.time"
)

missing_survival_columns <- setdiff(
  required_survival_columns,
  colnames(
    survival_data_raw
  )
)

if (length(missing_survival_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Missing survival columns:",
      paste(
        missing_survival_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}

survival_data <- survival_data_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    survival_sample = as.character(
      .data[[sample_column]]
    ),
    patient = substr(
      as.character(
        .data[[sample_column]]
      ),
      1,
      12
    ),
    OS = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        OS
      )
    ),
    OS_time = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        OS.time
      )
    )
  )

expression_patient_data <- sample_metadata %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    patient,
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    patient,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

survival_expression <- expression_patient_data %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    survival_data,
    by = "patient"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(OS),
    !is.na(OS_time),
    !is.na(target_expression),
    OS_time > 0
  )

survival_expression$target_group <- factor(
  survival_expression$target_group,
  levels = c(
    "Low",
    "High"
  )
)

cat(
  "\nPatients retained: ",
  nrow(
    survival_expression
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Deaths: ",
  sum(
    survival_expression$OS == 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Censored: ",
  sum(
    survival_expression$OS == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

write.csv(
  survival_expression,
  file.path(
    survival_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_survival_data.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 39. Kaplan-Meier survival analysis
#==============================================================================

km_fit <- survival::survfit(
  survival::Surv(
    OS_time,
    OS
  ) ~ target_group,
  data = survival_expression
)

logrank_test <- survival::survdiff(
  survival::Surv(
    OS_time,
    OS
  ) ~ target_group,
  data = survival_expression
)

logrank_p <- 1 - pchisq(
  logrank_test$chisq,
  df = length(
    logrank_test$n
  ) - 1
)

cat(
  "\nLog-rank P: ",
  signif(
    logrank_p,
    4
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

km_plot <- survminer::ggsurvplot(
  fit = km_fit,
  data = survival_expression,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.height = 0.25,
  pval = TRUE,
  pval.method = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  censor = TRUE,
  censor.shape = "|",
  censor.size = 3,
  palette = c(
    "blue",
    "red"
  ),
  legend.title = target_gene,
  legend.labs = c(
    "Low",
    "High"
  ),
  xscale = 30.44,
  xlab = "Overall survival (months)",
  ylab = "Overall survival probability",
  title = paste0(
    "TCGA-",
    tcga_project,
    " overall survival"
  ),
  subtitle = paste0(
    target_gene,
    "-high vs ",
    target_gene,
    "-low primary tumors"
  ),
  ggtheme = theme_classic(
    base_size = 13
  )
)

# Display plot.
print(
  km_plot
)

# Save PNG.
png(
  filename = file.path(
    survival_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_overall_survival_KM.png"
    )
  ),
  width = 3000,
  height = 2600,
  res = 300
)

print(
  km_plot
)

dev.off()

# Save PDF.
pdf(
  file = file.path(
    survival_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_overall_survival_KM.pdf"
    )
  ),
  width = 9,
  height = 8
)

print(
  km_plot
)

dev.off()


#==============================================================================
# 40. Cox model — high vs low
#==============================================================================

cox_group <- survival::coxph(
  survival::Surv(
    OS_time,
    OS
  ) ~ target_group,
  data = survival_expression
)

cox_group_summary <- summary(
  cox_group
)

group_term <- grep(
  "^target_group",
  rownames(
    cox_group_summary$coefficients
  ),
  value = TRUE
)[1]

cox_group_results <- data.frame(
  model = "High vs Low",
  hazard_ratio = cox_group_summary$coefficients[
    group_term,
    "exp(coef)"
  ],
  lower_95_CI = cox_group_summary$conf.int[
    group_term,
    "lower .95"
  ],
  upper_95_CI = cox_group_summary$conf.int[
    group_term,
    "upper .95"
  ],
  p_value = cox_group_summary$coefficients[
    group_term,
    "Pr(>|z|)"
  ]
)


#==============================================================================
# 41. Cox model — continuous expression
#==============================================================================

survival_expression <- survival_expression %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    target_expression_z = as.numeric(
      scale(
        target_expression
      )
    )
  )

cox_continuous <- survival::coxph(
  survival::Surv(
    OS_time,
    OS
  ) ~ target_expression_z,
  data = survival_expression
)

cox_continuous_summary <- summary(
  cox_continuous
)

cox_continuous_results <- data.frame(
  model = "Expression per 1 SD",
  hazard_ratio = cox_continuous_summary$coefficients[
    "target_expression_z",
    "exp(coef)"
  ],
  lower_95_CI = cox_continuous_summary$conf.int[
    "target_expression_z",
    "lower .95"
  ],
  upper_95_CI = cox_continuous_summary$conf.int[
    "target_expression_z",
    "upper .95"
  ],
  p_value = cox_continuous_summary$coefficients[
    "target_expression_z",
    "Pr(>|z|)"
  ]
)

cox_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cox_group_results,
  cox_continuous_results
)

cat(
  "\nCox proportional hazards results:\n\n"
)

print(
  cox_results
)

write.csv(
  cox_results,
  file.path(
    survival_results_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_Cox_results.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#==============================================================================
# 42. Proportional hazards checks
#==============================================================================

cox_group_ph <- survival::cox.zph(
  cox_group
)

cox_continuous_ph <- survival::cox.zph(
  cox_continuous
)

cat(
  "\nGrouped Cox proportional-hazards test:\n\n"
)

print(
  cox_group_ph
)

cat(
  "\nContinuous Cox proportional-hazards test:\n\n"
)

print(
  cox_continuous_ph
)


#==============================================================================
# 43. Save complete bulk validation object
#==============================================================================

bulk_validation_results <- list(
  settings = list(
    tcga_project = tcga_project,
    target_gene = target_gene,
    target_cutpoint = target_cutpoint,
    dea_fdr_threshold = dea_fdr_threshold,
    dea_logfc_threshold = dea_logfc_threshold,
    gsea_fdr_threshold = gsea_fdr_threshold
  ),
  clinical_data = clinical_data,
  sample_metadata = sample_metadata,
  expression_primary = expression_primary,
  dea_results = dea_results,
  hallmark_gsea = hallmark_gsea,
  gobp_gsea = gobp_gsea,
  immune_deconvolution = list(
    xcell = xcell_results,
    mcp_counter = mcp_results,
    estimate = estimate_results
  ),
  immune_statistics = immune_statistics,
  correlations = list(
    xcell = xcell_correlations,
    estimate = estimate_correlations
  ),
  survival = list(
    data = survival_expression,
    km_fit = km_fit,
    logrank_p = logrank_p,
    cox_group = cox_group,
    cox_continuous = cox_continuous,
    cox_results = cox_results
  )
)

saveRDS(
  bulk_validation_results,
  file.path(
    processed_data_directory,
    paste0(
      analysis_prefix,
      "_bulk_validation_results.rds"
    )
  )
)


#==============================================================================
# 44. Final summary
#==============================================================================

cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "TCGA BULK VALIDATION COMPLETE\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nTCGA project: ",
  tcga_project,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Target gene: ",
  target_gene,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Primary tumors: ",
  ncol(
    expression_primary
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nDifferential expression:\n"
)

cat(
  "  Upregulated: ",
  sum(
    dea_results$significance == "Up"
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "  Downregulated: ",
  sum(
    dea_results$significance == "Down"
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nGSEA:\n"
)

cat(
  "  Significant Hallmark pathways: ",
  sum(
    hallmark_gsea$padj < gsea_fdr_threshold,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "  Significant GOBP pathways: ",
  sum(
    gobp_gsea$padj < gsea_fdr_threshold,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nxCell:\n"
)

cat(
  "  Populations tested: ",
  nrow(
    xcell_correlations
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "  Significant correlations: ",
  sum(
    xcell_correlations$p_adjusted <
      correlation_fdr_threshold,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nESTIMATE / tumor purity:\n\n"
)

print(
  estimate_correlations %>%
    dplyr::select(
      cell_type,
      correlation,
      p_adjusted
    )
)

cat(
  "\nSurvival:\n"
)

cat(
  "  Patients: ",
  nrow(
    survival_expression
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "  Log-rank P: ",
  signif(
    logrank_p,
    4
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nCox results:\n\n"
)

print(
  cox_results
)

cat(
  "\nRaw bulk data:\n",
  tcga_directory,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nProcessed bulk data:\n",
  processed_data_directory,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nBulk results:\n",
  results_directory,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nBulk figures:\n",
  figures_directory,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n"
)
```
